vlan_id
Description
Returns the VLAN tag of the packet. This is a BIG-IP 4.X variable,
provided for backward-compatibility. You can use the equivalent 9.X
command
LINK::vlan_id
instead.
Syntax
vlan_id
vlan_id
Returns the VLAN tag of the packet.
